finalText:
Build's clean. 0 errors, exit code 0.

Two real bugs, both from the bundler bump changing shapes the code didn't adapt to:

1. `src/core/options.js:6` — read `options.retries` but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Crashed on `undefined.toFixed()`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — treated unset flags as an error, but the new config loader leaves them `undefined` instead of `false`. Now treated as `false` (disabled).

The other 8 warnings in the log (deprecated `fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, unused export, circular import, etc.) are pre-existing noise, not bump-caused — left alone since they don't break the build. Want those cleaned up too?
